info.title: Seed Audio 1.5 Audio Separation
info.description: Separate a mixed recording into individual tracks for dialogue, sound effects, and music. Each track is returned separately.

post.description:
> 🚧 **This model is not yet available.**

- Describe what to keep on each track, such as dialogue, sound effects, or background music.
- The source audio must be `2`–`360` seconds long.
- Processing is asynchronous. Use the returned task ID to [check the result](/en/api-manual/task-management/get-task-detail). Tasks cannot be cancelled after submission.
- Output links expire after 7 days. Save the files before then.

**Billing**

- Billable duration is the source duration multiplied by the number of output tracks. Billing is per second, with fractional seconds rounded up.
- At submission, `usage.credits_reserved` assumes `6` tracks of the source duration, the most the model returns, so your balance must cover that amount. If the source duration cannot be read, credits for `6` minutes × `6` tracks are reserved. On completion, billing uses the actual duration and track count. Excess credits are refunded and any shortfall is charged. Failed tasks receive a full refund.

**Task results when `status` is `completed`**

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| `results` / `result_data[i].audio_url` | Audio URLs for the individual tracks, in the same order in both fields. |
| `result_data[i].track_type` | Track type, such as `speaker` (voice), `sfx` (effects and ambience), or `bgm` (background music). Other types are possible. |
| `result_data[i].description` | Track name generated from the prompt. |
| `result_data[i].duration` | Track duration in seconds. |
| `usage.billed_seconds` / `usage.credits_used` | Billed seconds and credits actually used, respectively. |

prompt.description:
Specify how many tracks to create and what each one should contain. For example:

Split the recording into three tracks. Keep only dialogue on the first, footsteps, the doorbell, and room ambience on the second, and background music on the third.
prompt.example: Split the recording into three tracks. Keep only dialogue on the first, footsteps, the doorbell, and room ambience on the second, and background music on the third.

audio_urls.description:
Supply one source recording as a public URL. Voice IDs (`speaker://…`) are not supported.

- Duration: `2`–`360` seconds
- Formats: `wav` or `mp3`
- Maximum size: `90 MB`

format.description:
Output audio format

- `wav` (default) or `mp3`
- `ogg_opus` supports only `48000` Hz.
- `pcm` returns raw 16-bit audio without a header. Standard media players need additional processing to play it.

sample_rate.description: Output sample rate in Hz. For `wav`, `mp3`, and `pcm`, choose any listed rate (default `44100`). For `ogg_opus`, the only valid rate is `48000`, which is selected automatically if omitted.

callback_url.description:
HTTPS callback URL invoked when the task finishes

**When it fires:**
- Triggered when the task is completed, failed, or cancelled
- Sent after billing is finalized

**Security restrictions:**
- HTTPS only
- Callbacks to internal IP addresses are forbidden (127.0.0.1, 10.x.x.x, 172.16-31.x.x, 192.168.x.x, etc.)
- URL length must not exceed `2048` characters

**Callback mechanism:**
- Timeout: `10` seconds
- Up to `3` retries on failure (at `1` / `2` / `4` seconds after each failure)
- The callback body has the same format as the task-query response
- A 2xx response is treated as success; other status codes trigger a retry

can_cancel.description: Whether the task can be cancelled. This model does not support cancellation after submission.

credits_reserved.description: Credits reserved for six tracks of the source duration, or for 6 minutes × 6 tracks if the duration cannot be read. The final charge uses the actual duration and track count. Any difference is refunded or charged.
